item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #MINPRSD
Issued at 04:30 AM 23 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CotabatoCity, #LanaoDelSur(Balabagan, Kapatagan) and #MaguindanaoDelNorte(DatuOdinSinsuat) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthCotabato(Pigkawayan), #MaguindanaoDelNorte(Buldon, Barira, Parang, Matanog, SultanMastura and SultanKudarat) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
